Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production animation sprite sheet for Labcat desktop app, genuinely transparent RGBA background.
Input image 1 is the existing Labcat brand icon, a CHARACTER AND STYLE REFERENCE only; do not copy the flask-shaped head as a body. Expand the same dark forest-teal cat into a cute full-body character.
Character invariants: large rounded triangular cat head, pointed ears, simple warm cream round eyes, small triangular cream nose, two cream whisker strokes per cheek; short plump dark forest-teal body, small rounded paws, curling tail. Same character proportions, face, head shape in every frame. Flat clean illustration with subtle smooth shading matching icon, restrained forest green #174c40, sage, cream, and tiny coral accents. No outlines unless thin dark teal on props. Not pixel art, not photoreal, no clothes, no extra characters.
EXACT LAYOUT: 1536 pixels wide by 768 high, exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows, eight equal square 384x384 cells. Frame order left to right across first row, then second row. Every sprite centered within its own cell, baseline at 85% of cell height, constant scale and fixed camera. Keep entire character and props inside 72% of cell width/height, generous transparent padding on all sides. No objects crossing cell boundaries. Invisible grid, no dividers, no labels, no words, no frame numbers, no background, no ground shadow rectangle. Actual alpha transparency, NOT a checkerboard painted into the artwork. All eight cells must contain one full-body scene. Designed to look clear when each cell shown only 112px square.
SCENE: Cat sitting proudly facing camera, holding a rounded clear glass chemistry beaker with two paws in front of its belly. Small curled tail on right. Head and body stay in the same position.

These are decorative chemistry motion, NO percentage marks.
Frames7-8 are the completion flourish, same size and position: 7 a soft pastel foam bubble crown spills a little over beaker, cat delighted; 8 a few small round bubbles float above beaker, happy proud cat with one tiny coral sparkle. No dangerous chemistry, no flames. Maintain consistent cat identity in every frame. Exactly eight scenes, 4x2.
